aichat.desc: Tell me in one sentence what job you are looking for. I'll ask for everything the ad needs, one question at a time — 1–2 minutes.

aichat.note: Only what you tell me goes into the ad — I never invent experience, salary or anything else. At the end you check everything and publish it yourself.

aichat.q_name: What's your name? (shown in the ad)
aichat.q_phone: Type your phone number (for example: 90 123 45 67). It goes on your listing — employers unlock it and call you.
aichat.q_about: Last question: write 1–2 sentences about yourself — what you can do, whether you have transport, etc. Or tap “Write it from my answers”.
aichat.done: Done! The ad has everything it needs. Check it and publish.

U5.text: Find out about new replies and messages here.

B0.title: Meet the buttons
B0.text: Let's get to know the app's buttons in a minute.

B1.title: I'm looking for a job
B1.text: Looking for work? Tap this button. Pick a profession and region to see jobs or post a listing about yourself.

B2.title: I'm looking for a worker
B2.text: Need a worker? Tap this button to see workers or post a vacancy.

B3.title: Message box
B3.text: Type here in plain words, for example: "Cook job in Tashkent". The assistant will understand and find it.

B4.title: Search
B4.text: Search is this page. Wherever you are, this button brings you back here.

B5.title: My listings
B5.text: Your listings and their status are here.

B6.title: Post an ad
B6.text: Use this button to post a listing about yourself or a vacancy.

B7.title: Profile
B7.text: Your name, phone number, saved items and settings are here.

start_chat.title: Find and post
start_chat.ask_what: What would you like to do? Choose:
start_chat.ask_find_w: Type the job you want below and find it.
start_chat.ask_find_e: What worker do you need? Type below and find.

listing_image.ask_desc: AI draws a realistic picture for your listing. If you like it, the listing is posted with it; if not, make another or post without one.
listing_image.error_generic: The picture didn't work out right now. Try again a bit later.
listing_image.error_moderation: The image didn't pass the check. Make another or post without an image.
listing_image.error_user_limit: You've reached today's picture limit. Try again tomorrow.
listing_image.error_daily_limit: Picture creation is busy today. Try tomorrow.
listing_image.error_too_many: This image failed 3 times. Continue without one or try later.
listing_image.ready: Your listing will be posted with this image.
listing_image.error_provider_unavailable: The image service isn't working right now. You can post the listing without an image.

guided.hello: Find a job or a worker, easily
guided.placeholder_guest: For example: I need a driver
guided.placeholder_employer: E.g.: I need a sales clerk
guided.ask_role: Let me check one thing: are you looking for a job, or do you need a worker?
guided.ask_role_p: Let me check one thing: do you want to work as «{p}» yourself, or do you need a «{p}»?
guided.ask_prof_jobs: What's your profession? Pick below or type it.
guided.ask_prof_workers: What kind of worker do you need? Pick below or type it.
guided.ask_prof_unknown: I didn't understand the profession «{word}». Please type it differently — for example: driver, sales clerk, cook.
guided.ask_place_jobs: In which region do you want to work? Pick below.
guided.ask_place_workers: Which region should the worker be from? Pick below.
guided.none_post_worker: Post a listing about yourself — employers will find you.
guided.none_post_employer: Post a vacancy — workers will call you.
guided.post_employer: Great! Let's post the vacancy together — you'll answer a few questions.
guided.post_ask: What is the ad for: finding a worker or finding a job?
guided.post_intro: Great! Let's prepare a listing about you right here — I'll ask a few questions.
guided.ask_post_prof: What work do you do? Write your profession — for example: cook, driver, salesperson.
guided.ask_post_prof_unknown: I didn't understand the profession “{word}”. Try writing it differently — for example: cook, driver, salesperson.
guided.ask_post_region: Which region do you want to work in? Choose below.
guided.ask_post_region_tap: Choose the region with the buttons below.
guided.ask_post_name: What's your name? It will be shown in your listing.
guided.ask_post_name_retry: Write your name in letters — for example: Botir.
guided.ask_post_exp: Do you have experience? Write how many years you've worked (for example: 2 years) or choose below.
guided.ask_post_exp_retry: I didn't understand. Write how many years you've worked (for example: 2 years) or choose below.
guided.ask_post_phone: Write your phone number — employers will call this number. For example: 90 123 45 67
guided.ask_post_phone_retry: The number is incomplete. Write it like this: 90 123 45 67
guided.post_preview: Your listing will look like this:
guided.post_consent: By tapping “Post”, you agree that your listing and phone number will be shown to employers.
guided.post_login_note: To post, sign in once — your answers will be kept.
guided.post_done: Congratulations! Your listing is posted — employers can now find you.
guided.post_new_you: I want to post a listing about myself
guided.start_jobs_sub: Vacancies and a listing about you
guided.pick_none: Nothing found — try another word or type in the box below.
guided.ask_post_note: Anything to add? Pick below or type your own — e.g. I have a car. If not — “No notes”.
guided.suggest_jobs: Jobs are open right now in:
guided.suggest_workers: Workers are available right now in:

home.title: Your work starts here!
home.subtitle: Find a job or the worker you need.
home.placeholder: Type here — find what suits you

intro.title: How Ish topdim works
intro.s1: Hello! We're glad to see you.
intro.s2: This is Ish topdim: here you find both jobs and workers.
intro.s3: Looking for a job? Tap “I'm looking for a job”. Need a worker? Tap “I'm looking for a worker”.
intro.s4: Then pick your profession and region: browse listings or post your own.
intro.s5: Posting is easy — name, experience and phone, that's it!
intro.s6: If you have a question, type it in the box below.
